tasks.title: Add archived_at DB migration and Issue type
tasks.description: Add schema migration v16 to add `archived_at TEXT DEFAULT NULL` column to issues table with index. Add `archivedAt?: string` field to the Issue interface in types/index.ts. Update IssueRow interface and rowToIssue mapping in issue-repo.ts to include archived_at.
acceptanceCriteria: Migration v16 adds archived_at column with existence check
Index idx_issues_archived created on issues(archived_at)
Issue interface has optional archivedAt?: string field
rowToIssue maps archived_at from DB row
Existing tests pass (migration is additive)
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Follow existing pattern: SCHEMA_VERSION bump, migrateToVersionN with PRAGMA table_info check, transaction wrapping. Current version is 15.

tasks.title: Add IssueRepo archive methods and findAll filtering
tasks.description: Add archive(issueId), unarchive(issueId), findArchived(projectId) methods to IssueRepo. Extend IssueQueryOptions with includeArchived and archivedOnly fields. Modify findAll() to default-exclude archived issues (WHERE archived_at IS NULL) and support the new filter options.
acceptanceCriteria: archive(issueId) sets archived_at to current ISO timestamp and updates updated_at
unarchive(issueId) sets archived_at to NULL and updates updated_at
findArchived(projectId) returns issues with archived_at IS NOT NULL ordered by archived_at DESC
findAll() without options excludes archived (archived_at IS NULL)
findAll({ includeArchived: true }) returns all issues including archived
findAll({ archivedOnly: true }) returns only archived issues
Existing findAll callers unaffected (default behavior preserved)
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: findArchived can delegate to findAll({ archivedOnly: true, projectId }). The findAll SQL needs conditional WHERE clauses for archived_at.

tasks.title: Add IssueService archive/unarchive methods
tasks.description: Add archive(projectId, number, options?), unarchive(projectId, number), and archiveAllCompleted(projectId) methods to IssueService. The archive method checks for running agents (reject if active agent exists), sets archived_at via IssueRepo, and orchestrates resource cleanup (worktree removal via WorktreeManager.remove(), openspec archival via ChangeArtifactsManager.archiveChange(), checkpoint cleanup). Returns a result with warnings for non-done issues.
acceptanceCriteria: archive() sets archived_at on the issue
archive() rejects with error if issue has active agent session
archive() returns warning string if issue stage is not done
archive() calls WorktreeManager.remove() when cleanup=true
archive() skips worktree cleanup gracefully when worktree doesn't exist
archive() calls ChangeArtifactsManager.archiveChange() when cleanup=true
archive() skips openspec archival gracefully when changes dir doesn't exist
archive() with cleanup=false only sets archived_at, no resource cleanup
unarchive() clears archived_at, preserves original stage/status
unarchive() calls ChangeArtifactsManager.restoreChange() if archive exists
archiveAllCompleted() archives all stage=done issues with archived_at IS NULL sequentially
archiveAllCompleted() returns count of archived issues
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: WorktreeManager.remove() already exists and handles worktree+branch cleanup. ChangeArtifactsManager.archiveChange()/restoreChange() already exist. The service orchestrates these existing methods. For the date prefix on archived openspec dirs, call archiveChange() then rename to add YYYY-MM-DD- prefix.

tasks.title: Add archive API endpoints
tasks.description: Add POST /api/issues/:number/archive, POST /api/issues/:number/unarchive, and POST /api/issues/archive-completed endpoints to the issue routes. Modify GET /api/issues (list) to support ?archived=true and ?all=true query params, defaulting to exclude archived issues.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/issues/:number/archive returns 200 with archive result summary
POST /api/issues/:number/archive with {cleanup:false} skips resource cleanup
POST /api/issues/:number/archive returns 409 when issue has running agent
POST /api/issues/:number/archive returns 404 when issue doesn't exist
POST /api/issues/:number/unarchive returns 200 after clearing archived_at
POST /api/issues/:number/unarchive returns 400 when issue is not archived
POST /api/issues/archive-completed returns {archived: N} for batch
POST /api/issues/archive-completed returns {archived: 0, message: '...'} when none
GET /api/issues defaults to exclude archived (archived_at IS NULL)
GET /api/issues?archived=true returns only archived issues
GET /api/issues?all=true returns all issues including archived
GET /api/issues/:number response includes archived_at when present
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Follow existing route pattern using createIssueRoutes(). The archive-completed route must be registered BEFORE /:number routes to avoid path collision. Use ApiResponse<T> wrapper.

tasks.title: Add CLI archive/unarchive commands and list flags
tasks.description: Add `mo issue archive <number>`, `mo issue archive --all-completed`, `mo issue archive <number> --no-cleanup`, and `mo issue unarchive <number>` CLI subcommands. Add `--archived` and `--all` flags to `mo issue list`. Update list output formatting to show archived time and (archived) marker.
acceptanceCriteria: mo issue archive <number> calls POST /api/issues/:number/archive and shows result
mo issue archive --all-completed calls POST /api/issues/archive-completed
mo issue archive <number> --no-cleanup passes {cleanup:false} to API
mo issue unarchive <number> calls POST /api/issues/:number/unarchive
mo issue list (no flags) shows only active issues
mo issue list --archived shows only archived issues with archive timestamp
mo issue list --all shows all issues, archived ones marked (archived)
Error messages displayed for not-found and not-archived cases
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Follow existing command pattern with setupIssueCommands(program). All commands use shared apiClient from ../api-client. Archive command with --all-completed should NOT require a number argument.
